en-US.description: Next-Gen LLM Gateway & AI Asset Platform
en-US.longDescription: New API is a next-generation large model gateway and AI asset management system, developed based on One API. The project aims to provide a unified interface for managing and utilizing various AI model services, including but not limited to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Midjourney.
